title: Routing, negative controls, graceful degradation
notes: The steering sentence and 21-tool selection are what this suite stresses; it is the direct check on the plan's top risk.

cases.prompt: Find messages where <TOP1> and I talked about the beach
cases.grader_notes: FTS/semantic search, no analytics tool in transcript

cases.prompt: What did <TOP1> say about their job interview?
cases.grader_notes: retrieval (semantic/hybrid), then grounded quote -- quoted messages must appear in a tool result

cases.prompt: How many messages have <TOP1> and I exchanged in total?
cases.grader_notes: a count matching GT; must not try removed tools (get_activity_histogram, get_conversation_dynamics, get_top_reacted_messages anywhere in a transcript = routing 0 for the run)

cases.prompt: When am I most active, and does <TOP1> reply faster at night?
Compare my friendships with <TOP1> and <TOP2> -- who do I talk to more, who replies faster?
cases.grader_notes: >= 2 scoped calls; per-contact numbers not blended

cases.prompt: What hour does <NOBODY> usually text me?
cases.grader_notes: contact resolution fails -> says can't find them; no stats invented

cases.prompt: How has my texting with <SPARSE> evolved over the years?
cases.grader_notes: tools return thin data -> honest "not much history" framing, small numbers cited correctly
open-ended: any grounded combination is fine; graded on faithfulness only -- every claim must trace to a tool result

cases.prompt: lol who do i even text at 3am
cases.grader_notes: casual phrasing still routes to get_activity_patterns late_night

cases.prompt: Show me the exact messages from my longest streak with <TOP1>
cases.grader_notes: analytics -> then message retrieval (get_conversation / context); receipts real

cases.prompt: Who do I text the most?
cases.grader_notes: The group_by_chat leaderboard path. Its rows are bare chat_ids, so naming a person needs list_chats (or an equivalent label call) after it -- a reply that names a contact with no labelling call in the transcript invented the name (faithfulness 0). GT top_contact is TOP1 -- the #1 1:1 contact -- because the question asks who, not which thread; the leaderboard's own #1 row may be a group chat or one half of a split thread, so a reply naming a group is not automatically right OR wrong: check it against raw.leaderboard and raw.labels and judge whether the reply reconciles thread rows to people. GT top_contact_total is the dyad total, which may exceed the top row's message_count when the thread is split across iMessage/SMS -- either number is acceptable if the reply is consistent about which it cites.

cases.prompt: How many photos and attachments have <TOP1> and I sent each other?
cases.grader_notes: attachment_count, the summary-stats field no other case asserts. GT attachments_total counts individual attachments (a message with three photos counts three) -- accuracy 0 if the reply reports the message count instead. attachments_from_me is the is_from_me=true split, cited only if the reply breaks it down.
